President Paul Kagame (2nd Right) presides over FIA Awards Ceremony, Kigali, 13 December 2024

South African Sports Minister Gayton McKenzie has welcomed Rwanda’s reported bid to host a Formula 1 Grand Prix from 2030, saying the East African country has worked longer on its campaign and deserves the opportunity.

McKenzie’s comments come as Rwanda’s plans to bring Formula 1 back to Africa gain momentum, with a new permanent circuit planned near Bugesera International Airport, about 40 kilometres east of the capital Kigali.

Speaking about the emerging Rwandan bid, McKenzie said South Africa should recognise the work Rwanda has already put into its campaign rather than view the development as a threat to its own ambitions.

He said Rwanda had been working on its Formula 1 plans for longer than South Africa and therefore deserved recognition for the progress it had made.

At the same time, McKenzie made clear that South Africa has not abandoned its own ambition of returning the country to the Formula 1 calendar.

He said South Africa could still secure a Grand Prix before 2030, leaving open the possibility that both countries could eventually feature on the Formula 1 calendar.

McKenzie argued that Africa should not be restricted to a single Formula 1 race simply because the continent has historically been absent from the championship.

With 55 countries on the continent, he said, there was room for more than one African Grand Prix if the necessary infrastructure, investment and commercial conditions could be met.

The comments add a new dimension to the growing competition to bring Formula 1 back to Africa, with Rwanda and South Africa emerging as the two countries at the centre of the latest push.

Rwanda has built its campaign around a new circuit, while South Africa is looking to revive its historic Formula 1 presence at Kyalami, which last hosted the South African Grand Prix in 1993.

Kyalami remains one of Africa’s best-known racing venues, but the circuit would need to regain the FIA Grade 1 status required to host a Formula 1 race.

Rwanda, meanwhile, is pursuing a different route by developing a new permanent circuit. The proposed track is expected to be located close to Bugesera Airport and would be designed by former Formula 1 driver Alexander Wurz.

Rwanda has also strengthened its links with the international motorsport community in recent years. Kigali hosted the FIA General Assembly and awards ceremony in 2024, bringing senior figures from global motorsport to the country.

President Paul Kagame has also repeatedly expressed Rwanda’s interest in bringing Formula 1 to the country and has engaged with Formula 1 and FIA leadership.

For Formula 1, the return to Africa would mark a major expansion of the championship’s global footprint. The continent has not hosted a Grand Prix since the 1993 South African race at Kyalami.

Rwanda’s reported 2030 target therefore comes as Formula 1 continues to consider how and where the championship can return to Africa.

McKenzie’s response suggests that South Africa sees Rwanda’s progress as a development that can coexist with its own ambitions.

Rather than presenting the two bids as mutually exclusive, the South African minister has argued that Africa could eventually accommodate multiple races.

For now, Rwanda’s proposed 2030 race remains a confirmed Formula 1 calendar event. But with South Africa maintaining its own ambitions, the race to bring Formula 1 back to Africa is increasingly becoming a contest involving more than one country.

Rusizi: Abarimu bo mu murenge wa Kamembe, bavuga ko kuba bamwe muri bo bakora akazi bataha kure y’imiryango yabo, bikiri imbogamizi y’uburezi bufite ireme.

Ku wa Mbere tariki ya 5 Ukwakira 2026, abarimu bizihije Umunsi mpuzamahanga wa Mwarimu, bavuze ko bishimira ko ari umwanya mwiza wo guhurira hamwe bakaganira ku kazi bakora.

Bizimana Edigar, ni umwarimu mu mashuri abanza, mu kigo cy’ishuri rya GS St Jean Bosco Cyangugu, yavuze ko kwizihiza Umunsi mpuzamahanga wa Mwarimu, bituma bahurira hamwe bakaganira ku murimo bakora. Yanagaragaje ko, abakora uyu murimo bataha kure y’imiryango yabo bigira ingaruka ku burezi.

Ati “Uyu munsi wa mwarimu ni uw’ibyishimo uduhuza n’abandi tukaganira. Imbogamizi mwarimu agifite ni ugukorera kure y’urugo rwe, iyo adatekanye bigira ingaruka ku ntego z’uburezi dufite.”

Duhoranimana Clementine ni umwarimu muri GS Gihundwe B. na we yavuze ko uyu munsi wa Mwarimu utuma bahurira hamwe bakishima, agaragaza kuba hari bamwe bakorera kure y’ingo zabo bikiri imbogamizi ikomeye ituma mwarimu adatanga umusaruro uko bikwiriye.

Ati “Imbogmizi mwarimu agihura na zo ni uko mu gihe cyo gutanga akazi ku barimu bashya hari ubwo usanga bagushyize kure y’urugo rwawe.”

Aba barimu mu cyifuzo cyabo basaba inzego zibishinzwe ko mu gihe cyo gutanga akazi ku barimu bashya hajya hitabwa ku myirondoro yabo bagashyirwa mu bigo by’amashuri bibari hafi.

‎Minisitiri w’Uburezi, Nsengimana Joseph mu mwaka ushize wa 2025, ubwo yavugaga ku kibazo cy’abarimu basaba kwimurwa aho bokorera, yatangaje ko nubwo bifuza ko imyaka yo kwimurwa yagabanuka, bakwiye no kwita ku kureba ku banyeshuri bahindurirwa abarimu buri gihe.

Yanavuze ko nk’inzego zishinzwe uburezi ziteguye kwicarana na bo bakareba icyakorwa mu rwego rwo korohereza impande zose.

Imibare ya Ministeri y’Uburezi (MINEDUC) igaragaza ko abarimu bose hamwe mu Rwanda barenga ibihumbi 120, bigisha mu mashuri y’imyuga n’ubumenyi ngiro (TVET) no mu burezi rusange.

Abigisha mu burezi bw’ibanze barimo 64 11o bo mu mashuri abanza, 34 379 bo mashuri yisumbuye, mu gihe mu mashuri y’inshuke ari 9 252.

Abarimu bafite impamyabumenyi y’amashuri yisumbuye (A2) bose hamwe bangana na 75 324, barimo 1 973 bigisha mu mashuri yisumbuye, 64 099 bo mu mashuri abanza, na 9 252 bigisha mu mashuri y’inshuke.

Abafite impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza (A1) bose hamwe ni 8 547 aho hafi ya bose bigisha mu yisumbuye n’undi umwe rudori wigisha mu y’abanza.

Abafite impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri (A0) bose ni 23 870, abigisga mu yisumbuye ni 23 860,

Mu mwaka w’amashuri 2023/2024 imibare ya REB igaragaza ko abarimu 2, 235 basabye guhabwa kwimurwa, muri bo 1,226 ni bo bari bujuje ibisabwa, ariko 751 ni bo bemerewe.
